title: Broken Charter
summary: Start: enter Broken Charter. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Stamp Clerk. Do: come within 320 meters of the Stamp Clerk. The clerk slides alongside and reads the first stamp. An ambush holds the home buoy until 520 meters. Finish: after the clerk is met, come inside First Stamp's shell. The Charter writes standing. Planting starts the dispute. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
